newsitem.title: USA: Richardson Electronics completes debt swap.
newsitem.headline: Richardson Electronics completes debt swap.

text.p: Richardson Electronics Ltd said Wednesday it completed its offer to the holders of its 7-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due December 15, 2006 for a new issue of 8-1/4 percent senior subordinated debentures due June 15, 2006.
The company said $48.1 million worth of the old debentures were tendered for exchange and it was accepting the offer's maximum amount of $40 million on a pro rata basis.
Richardson Electronics distributes electron tubes, microwave components and semiconductors.
Its shares closed unchanged Wednesday at 8-1/2.
